summary.text: Ericsson develops and supplies telecommunications infrastructure, cloud software and services across networks, cloud, OSS/BSS, automation/AI and enterprise connectivity. The company emphasizes R&D (including 6G), AI-enabled autonomous network operations, Open RAN and fintech platform offerings and works with global partners and service providers.
